hypothesis: Back edge has no head over the frozen A3 scope; confirming 8 more train card boxes raises usable train back-edge units to 118 (65 normal/53 positive). A single linear head with the existing weak-presence recipe on 448 DINOv2 area crops may reach the C1 back-edge FN/FP ceilings.
change: New back-edge area head only: fixed DINOv2 vits14 448 area crops, fit_detail_head max_bound normal bags, weak presence positives (no points), L2=1, group and class mass, threshold .5, one fit on train units, no tuning. Control is the degenerate all-normal reference (score 0).
